name: org_graph_changes_between
description: What changed in the Org Graph between two dates: joiners (with every fact and membership and the units they own on their first day), leavers, person fact changes (title, level, manager, cost centre, site, employment), memberships started, ended or changed, moves between units, and units created, renamed, moved, retyped, retired, succeeded or re-owned. by "effective" (the default) lists what took effect after from, up to and including to; known_on reads what the Org Graph knew at the end of that date in the tenant's time zone. by "learned" lists what the Org Graph learned after the end of from, up to the end of to, in the tenant's time zone, whatever date it took effect, so backdated corrections show, and a change it no longer believes comes back withdrawn. A change's effective_on is the first day it holds, so a leaving dated 30 April shows on 1 May. Defaults to a count per kind, with withdrawn changes counted apart; mode "full" lists every change, and only tenant admins and Org Graph editors may ask for it. People are named by id only.

from.description: Date, YYYY-MM-DD. The day before the window opens.

to.description: Date, YYYY-MM-DD. The window's last day.

known_on.description: Date, YYYY-MM-DD. By effective date only; omit for what is known now.
